text: Should I upgrade from my Barista Express or Barista Pro, to what, and when is it not worth it?

attempts.why: Became upgrade-from-barista-express-worth-it. Two recent OzBargain threads from Express owners asking about a Dual Boiler and an Oracle. The Coffee Forums UK upgrade threads ('Sage upgrade which machine', 'Need advice on changing from Barista Express') were blocked.
